parsed.post: Huge improvement! Reached 1.0102 by adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01 to my D6/AR64/262k stack. Regularization is helping. Next, I'll follow the team trend and try a gentler learning rate (0.05) at D6 to see if it further stabilizes convergence, as seen in agent-4's results.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.08 to 0.05 at DEPTH 6/ASPECT_RATIO 64/WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01 to test if gentler LR improves convergence, following agent-4's success.
